decision.rationale: v11 is a faithful leftover remasurement. Its premise was verified rather than assumed: v10 does cite occupancy v3 and never occupancy v4 or D-220, so a remasurement after D-220 is warranted. What it changed is exactly what a remasurement should change and nothing else, established by field-level diff rather than by reading prose: no key removed, no obligation measurement altered, summary.leftoverDesign still exactly [OBL-FX-AUTHORING], with the nineteen changes confined to identity, pins, the occupancy retarget and rewritten prose, and the forty-six additions confined to the new occupancy v4, predecessorV10, decision and parentReview provenance. Every citation resolves: 102 digests recomputed with zero mismatches, three cited commits confirmed present with matching subjects and ancestry, and every derived claim about a parent artifact re-derived from that parent's own bytes rather than trusted. The constructions this lineage has broken on before are all held: the version-collision class is guarded by family-qualification even where doctor-actor v11 now collides with this artifact's own version number, the after-successor currency of v10 is qualified everywhere it is stated while its draft-time currency was independently confirmed against COORD, predecessorV10.recording is D-189 as required, basedOn.d256.role is last-heading custody only, parentReview names naming v6 as naming parent, and the leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded token is absent. All twenty prompt attacks plus two of this reviewer's own were run and all twenty-two were refuted. Three candidate defects were examined seriously and all three proved true-in-these-bytes rather than false. Zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX stand.
